note: CONSTITUTION Art. XIII.4: the declared interaction model. Screens name visible regions, not exclusive routes; unavailable retains stale content with commands disabled and a real refresh path. enabled_when is a Python boolean expression checked against the served DOM. Response rendering tests inject negative replies at the real HTTP handler boundary; only separate Owner tests establish the actual refusal cause. reject-offset declares the Lean correction-transition REJECTED vocabulary. decide opens the Decide sheet, a dialog whose radios, reason, Cancel and confirm are declared in local_controls by role and name; the two outcomes each POST their own route from the sheet. Defensive integrity codes unreachable through the other fixed UI commands remain outside this response inventory; no exhaustive Owner failure claim follows from the browser crawl.
